name: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
storyline: Three hundred years ago, five heroes are said to have defeated the ancient dragon Akashidon, and the five nations of Hyogoslavia have lived in uneasy peace ever since. Tamon, the gentle and indecisive second prince of Settsu, has always quietly accepted the path laid out for him. But when he sets out on a journey across the five nations, he meets Yura of Awaji, Nishiki of Tamba, and Natsume of Tajima, and is drawn into a story where the ambitions of each nation intersect.
summary: Hyogoslavia Chronicles is an RPG that reimagines Japan’s Hyogo Prefecture as Hyogoslavia, a medieval European-style federation of five nations: Settsu, Harima, Tamba, Tajima, and Awaji. Taking its name from a Japanese internet meme, the game tells a story in which the ambitions of the five nations intersect. The party includes Tamon, the indecisive second prince of Settsu; Yura of Awaji, a strong-willed fighter who dreams of leading the water army; Nishiki, an herbalist from Tamba; and Natsume of Tajima, who senses the ley lines and hears the voices of nature. Recovery items are based on Hyogo’s local specialties, and an optional “Settsu-go” mode lets players experience all dialogue in the Kobe dialect. The game features multiple endings.
